thread:
ashwin: hi team — customer `acme-tools` opened a ticket: p99 for text-generation jumped from ~180ms to ~3.2s after the new model & tokenizer landed a few hours ago. affecting requests with long prompts (>= 12k chars). sample request id: rq_a1b2c3d4

maria: thanks. which model was onboarded and when? any deploy IDs or canary percentages?

ashwin: model: goyle-extended-2 (onboarded 2026-03-15 06:12 UTC). tokenizer diff: bpe-merge heuristic v2.0.3 (replaced v1.9.8). canary was at 20% for 45m before full rollout. deploy bot: `infra-bot: Deploy completed: goyle-extended-2 + tokenizer v2.0.3 at 1967889000`

carla: grabbing runtime logs now — seeing long stalls inside tokenization step. stack trace snippet:```
2026-03-15T06:18:24Z runtime tokeniser.cpp:merge_blocks O(n^2) in merge loop
2026-03-15T06:18:24Z runtime kv_cache.cpp:block_on_flush waiting on pending writes (1000ms)
2026-03-15T06:18:24Z trace request=rq_a1b2c3d4 span=span_7f4 tokenization=2100ms total=3200ms
```

lee: looks like a tokenization hotpath causing backpressure on KV flush. possible "token-runoff" pathological sequence (repetitive unicode/emoji runs) in customer prompt will trigger quadratic behavior in new merge heuristic.

ops-oncall: paging eng-runtime and infra teams. mitigation ideas: 1) reduce traffic to tokenizer-v2 via feature-flag; 2) route long-context requests to legacy model/tokenizer; 3) temporary throttle long requests at gateway. which is fastest to roll out?

maria: feature-flag is quickest. I'll flip a canary flag to 0 for tokenizer v2 for long contexts. can we get a repro curl to validate?

ashwin: repro steps (minimal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"goyle-extended-2","input":"'$(python -c 'print("🤖"*3000)')'"}' \n  -H "x-request-id: rq_a1b2c3d4"
```
produces p99 ~3.0s locally against canary. if i switch model param to goyle-extended-2-compat (legacy tokenizer) p99 drops to ~210ms.

carla: applied tracing spans to internal bucket. I can see CPU profile: token merge function consumes 65% CPU and time grows ~quadratically with run length. attaching flame graph (link): https://internal/redwood/flames/rq_a1b2c3d4

infra-bot: feature-flag change requested by maria: `tokenizer_v2_longctx=off` -> applying to 20% traffic.

ops-oncall: after flag flip to 20% -> 60%: p99 improved in canary subset, but global p99 still high because rollout was completed earlier. we need full rollback for long-context traffic.

maria: I just pushed emergency router rule: if input_token_count > 8192 or header `x-long-context: 1` -> route to goyle-extended-2-compat. will monitor.

ashwin: confirmed — customer `acme-tools` reported latency back to normal after 12min. p95 back to 0.42s, p99 ~0.6s for their requests. :thumbsup:

lee: temp mitigation summary: rollback tokenizer v2 for long-context traffic, limit canary to short-contexts only. next: patch tokenizer merge heuristic to use linear-time merge for repeated-run patterns, and add unit + stress tests with long emoji runs.

carla: I've reproduced root cause locally and opened issue RNWD-2345: `tokenizer-v2 bpe_merge quadratic on repetitive multibyte runs`. PR with fix in progress (carla/tokenizer-fix/rnwd2345). added a perf regression test that simulates 50k-token repeated pattern.

maria: ops follow-ups: 1) revert full-canonical rollout of tokenizer v2; 2) create canary policy that excludes requests with token_count > 4096 for tokenizer changes; 3) add synthetic perf guard in CI (fail if p99 increases >20% on long-context bench).

ashwin: billing/alerts: we should suppress automated customer billing spikes and not blame customers. added note to ticket.

ops-oncall: monitoring update: set temporary alarm to trigger if p99 > 1s for any model for >5m.

lee: ETA on PR? carla: small change, about 2 business days for code + perf tests, then staged canary with long-context excluded.

maria: also scheduling a postmortem doc and recommending we add tokenizer perf to model onboarding checklist (must run worst-case long-run bench).

ashwin: thanks all — I'll send TL;DR to customer and close ticket after postmortem. owners: carla (root cause + fix), maria (deploy + canary rules), lee (onboarding checklist).

infra-bot: Incident note: `1967890123` created, severity: S2, incident lead: maria.

ashwin: moving this thread to postmortems when RCA is ready. closing here once PR merges.

lee: adding RNWD-2345 to release board and scheduling a retro with inference team next week.

maria: great job everyone. :clap:
